brief:
An Israeli weather forecaster mocked Palestinians in Gaza as their tents flooded with rainwater, Middle East Eye reported. Tzachi Peleg's comments came as displaced residents dealt with the consequences of heavy rain on their temporary shelters in the territory.

The remarks drew attention to conditions facing Gaza's displaced population, many of whom are sheltering in tents after being forced from their homes during the ongoing conflict.
dek: 'Such happiness...': Israeli forecaster mocks Palestinians over flooded tents Israeli forecaster Tzachi Peleg has mocked Gaza’s displaced residents as their tents were flood by rainwater.
title: Israeli weather forecaster mocks Palestinians over flooded Gaza tents
